newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMLC Beef Weekly - Australian export prices.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMLC Beef Weekly - Australian export prices.

text.p: Australian Meat and Livestock Corp's (AMLC) weekly export prices are as follows:
AUSTRALIAN EXPORT PRICES TO U.S. IN U.S. CENTS/LB, CIF.
Bull (95 Chemical Lean) 86 +1 on last week
AUSTRALIAN EXPORT PRICES TO JAPAN IN U.S. CENTS/LB CIF.
Chilled grassfed fullsets 134 -3 on last week

More than 70,000 sheep were offered for sale this week but a large portion included poor quality drafts from southern districts. Quality is affected by hot and dry conditions. Good quality sheep sold at rates equivalent to the eastern states.
Trade weight and store lamb prices rose by up to A$5.00 a head in NSW although price rises were more subdued for other categories such as export and heavy weight trade lambs.

The major news from Australian saleyards this week has been price rises for sheep and lambs. This continues the trend of higher prices over the last month, especially in South Australia, NSW and Victoria.

Prices for wethers have generally risen by 20-30 cents a kg to 65-75 cents a kg dressed weight over the month, probably reflecting processor concern about availability of stock. Good rains in the eastern states over the past month have lessened the need to turn stock off. In Western Australia, quality is a problem.
